meta.title: Specimen Sorter API - Screen vs API
meta.subject: Manual Spec Ack actions versus the sorter POST
meta.author: LIS Team

slides.headline:
Specimen Sorter API
Screen vs the POST
slides.lede: Each Spec Ack action today is a staff click. The sorter POST must do the same work, then return Registered, Send-out, Relabel, or Failure.
slides.footer: From 01 Requirement and 02 System Design  ·  staff path unchanged
slides.notes: This is a walkthrough of what moves off the screen, not a CP3 recap. Staff Specimen Acknowledgement stays as the fallback for Relabel and Failure.

slides.title: One slide per Spec Ack action

items.title: Retrieve GCRS order
items.note: USID only, as the sorter user

slides.notes: Walk left to right as the POST does: retrieve, then send-out or register packing, then print and PHLC only if Registered.

slides.title: The screen still owns the click path. The POST owns the sorter path.
slides.lede: Middleware sends a USID and sorter id. LIS decides the bin. Staff Spec Ack does not change.

proofs.title: Today
proofs.body: Staff scan, see alerts, press Send-out or Register. Packing and checks run on the screen first.

proofs.title: The POST
proofs.body: One call on the Spec Ack service. Same retrieve, send-out, register, print, and PHLC writes. Soft text stays off the body.

proofs.title: Fallback
proofs.body: Relabel and Failure bins go back to staff Spec Ack. No new screen.

slides.goal: Confirm each action below matches today's Spec Ack rule, except mixed send-out and the staff checkbox.
slides.notes: Do not reuse the staff register endpoint. The sorter never calls the retrieve GET that hard-codes a demo user.

slides.title: Staff can search several keys. The sorter sends a USID only.

left.label: Manual
left.title: Scan or type, then retrieve
points: Staff enter specimen no., lab no., or order no.
Format, allowed sending hospital, and check digit run first.
Not found stops the screen (1336 / 1337 / 1338 / 1377).
Retrieve GET on the service uses a hard-coded demo user.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: USID, as the mapped user
points: Body needs usid and sorterId. No order-no or request-no lookup.
Same format, allowed hospital, and check digit. Miss is Failure.
Retrieve runs in-process as the sorter LIS user, not the demo user.
Optional HKID or name, if sent and wrong, is Failure. APS / BBS / MBS is Failure.

callout.text: Hospital omitted on the POST is taken from the sorter map and workbench.

slides.notes: Say that the GET retrieve stays for staff. The sorter must not call it. CPS and HMS only in v1. DFT and STAR on those labs still retrieve.

slides.title: Staff press Send-out. The POST looks up the cluster list.

left.label: Manual
left.title: Click after the order is on screen
points: Staff decide Send-out from what they see.
Backend acks a Printed or Collected specimen, writes tracking, and writes SEND_OUT.
A GCRS test is send-out when its cluster code is on the send-out list for that lab and hospital.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same list, no staff click
points: Join the test code to the send-out list for lab and hospital.
All tests on the list: existing send-out write, status SEND_OUT.
Local and send-out on the same USID: Failure. Do not send out a subset.
No worksheet and no PHLC on this path.

callout.text: The sorter does not send a send-out flag. The list decides.

slides.notes: Name the list as the send-out test table if asked, not as a Flex routine. Audit will add SORT_SO beside the existing SEND_OUT write in a later package.

slides.headline: Three screen jobs sit in front of Register
slides.body: Checks. Test groups and request no. Ward and doctor mapping. The POST must do all three before it calls register.
slides.notes: Register on the service already expects a packed request. That is why middleware cannot call the staff register endpoint as-is.

slides.title: Staff see popups. The POST logs soft ones and fails hard ones.

left.label: Manual
left.title: Alerts on the screen
points: Soft alerts after retrieve. Staff can continue or stop.
Hard checks before Register: mapping, datetime, test, specimen state.
Mixed local and send-out is a soft alert today.
Staff can tick Relabel USID. STAR unbox can warn, then block if no location.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same rules, no dialogue
points: Soft alerts: ALS only. Not on the response body. Status is not Relabel.
Hard checks: HTTP 200 and FAILURE, with the message code on the audit remark.
Mixed local and send-out is Failure on the API.
No Relabel checkbox. STAR with no workbench location is Failure 4422.

callout.text: Ack and register time is server now. Missing collection date is soft. Do not invent a date.

slides.notes: The mixed-path change is the one to say out loud. Staff can still proceed after that popup. The sorter cannot split the tube.

slides.title: Soft alerts the API logs and then continues

cards.title: Missing collection date
cards.body: Proceed. Do not invent a collection date.

cards.title: Overnight specimen
cards.body: Same overnight window as Spec Ack. ALS warn only.

cards.title: Valid period / sex-age
cards.body: Test validity and valid-period warnings. ALS only.

cards.title: Duplicate / A-A-R
cards.body: Duplicate-reason and A-A-R-not-ready prompts. ALS only. AAR stays off.

cards.title: Patient tag / private
cards.body: Private patient and patient-tag alerts. ALS only.

cards.title: STAR unbox alert
cards.body: Boxed-specimen warning is ALS. No workbench location is hard Failure, not this card.

callout.text: BBS blood / category / T&S alerts stay on the staff screen. BBS is out of v1.

slides.notes: These are the R6 soft set. Mixed is not on this slide because the locked design made it Failure.

slides.title: Hard checks that return Failure

rows: Doctor, location, specialty, report dest, or report copy has no LIS id
Collection before DOB; ack before collection or request; ack in the future
Already used, all registered, all deleted, specimen deleted or rejected
STAR specimen and workbench has no location
Local and send-out tests on the same USID

takeaways.title: Also Failure
takeaways.body: Missing test dictionary, patient HKID or name mismatch, APS / BBS / MBS, unknown sorter id.

takeaways.title: Not Failure
takeaways.body: Overnight, valid period, duplicate, patient tag, missing collection date, STAR unbox alert.

slides.notes: Walk the five rows, then the takeaway for test-dict and identity mismatch. Do not auto-create an unmapped doctor or location.

slides.title: USID becomes the request no. only when the tube can carry it.

left.label: Manual
left.title: Screen groups tests, then assigns
points: Tests are grouped before Register. Each group needs a request no.
USID can be the request no. when the screen says it is eligible.
Staff can tick Relabel USID and force a new label.
More than one group, multi-specimen, suffix not 0, DFT same time-flag, or force relabel: do not use USID.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same grouping. No checkbox.
points: Same grouping and the same Relabel rules, without a user Relabel tick.
Single group, one specimen, suffix 0, not force-relabel: request no. = USID.
Otherwise return Relabel. Do not write a lab request. Do not invent a number.
Caller cannot send an assigned request no. Auto-gen-only is still Relabel.

callout.text: Relabel is its own status. It is not Failure and not Registered.

slides.notes: Partial DFT remainder is Relabel as well. DFT still uses Spec Ack register later, not the DFT register API.

slides.title: The screen maps office codes. The POST fails if a map is missing.

left.label: Manual
left.title: Map, then popup if empty
points: Request doctor, request location, specialty, report destination, and report copy are mapped from dictionary.
Unmapped doctor, location, specialty, dest, or copy blocks Register.
Staff can create a doctor from the screen when dictionary allows it.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same map. No create.
points: Same five mappings go onto the packed register call.
Any miss is Failure with the same message codes as Spec Ack.
Do not auto-create a doctor or a location. Send the tube to staff Spec Ack.

callout.text: Do not compare workbench lab to the order test lab.

slides.notes: Report destination can follow request location when that Spec Ack option is on. The convertor already does that; the API ports it, it does not invent a new rule.

slides.title: Staff pick a worksheet. The POST prints every one, after it has already returned.

left.label: Manual
left.title: Print after Register
points: After a successful register, staff can print GCRS, send-out, and SH worksheets.
If more than one worksheet, staff pick which to print.
Labels can also print on the staff path.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Print all, off the wait
points: Return REGISTERED first. Then print every worksheet Spec Ack would have. No picker.
Send-out, Relabel, and Failure print nothing.
No labels. Late worksheet is allowed. Print fail is ALS warn; status stays Registered.

callout.text: p95 under 4 seconds is retrieve plus send-out or register. Print is not on that clock.

slides.notes: Same three staff print services, in-process, no HTTP loopback. Registration only. A send-out form after local register is still a worksheet on that path, not a print after SEND_OUT.

slides.title: PHLC stays a backend create. The POST calls it only after Registered.

left.label: Manual
left.title: Screen calls PHLC after register
points: After Register, Spec Ack creates a PHLC electronic order when the lab option is on.
Destination must match the PHLC rule Spec Ack already uses.
Staff wait on the screen for that call.

right.label: Sorter POST
right.title: Same create, after HTTP return
points: Same PHLC create as Spec Ack, in-process, after REGISTERED is already back.
Only when Spec Ack would send to PHLC. Send-out, Relabel, and Failure skip it.
PHLC fail is ALS warn. The sorter status stays Registered.

callout.text: No labels on the sorter path. Worksheet and PHLC never run on Send-out.

slides.notes: PHLC is already backend today. The change is when it runs and that the sorter does not wait. Do not invent a new PHLC contract.

slides.headline: One POST. Four bins.
slides.note: Retrieve plus send-out or register. Print and PHLC after the status is already back.

nextSteps.title: Keep the staff path
nextSteps.body: Spec Ack retrieve, Send-out, and Register stay. Relabel and Failure go there.

nextSteps.title: Move the three register jobs
nextSteps.body: Checks, grouping and request no., ward and doctor. Then the existing register write.

nextSteps.title: Print only when Registered
nextSteps.body: All worksheets, then PHLC, after HTTP return. No labels.

slides.notes: Close on the latency split so print arguments do not reopen the 4 second budget.
